rationale: The agent verified the user by full name and ZIP, matching a single account before proceeding. It located the correct tablet order, provided the tracking number, and then sought explicit confirmation before each order-changing action. It submitted a return for the delivered tablet, canceled the pending charger order with a stated reason, canceled the pending hiking boots and electric kettle order, and submitted a return for the delivered sneakers. All actions aligned with order statuses and tool outputs, and refunds/return processes were communicated accurately. No unsupported claims or actions on the wrong account were made.
